Ear: Point index finger to earlobe or touch the ear.
Eye: Point index finger gently towards eye or outline eyebrow.
Nose: Touch the tip of the nose with index fingertip.
Mouth: Circle or point index finger around the lips.
Head: Pat or tap side of head with flat open palm.
Hair: Pinch a strand of hair between thumb and index finger.
Hands: Hold both open palms up and rotate wrists back and forth.
Nail: Tap fingernail of opposite index finger with thumb.
Face: Circle flat open palm in front of the entire face.
Heart: Place right hand flat over left side of chest over heart.
Fever: Place back of hand against forehead checking temperature.
Cough: Hold curved fist over mouth and cough motion.
Medicine: Rub middle finger in circular motion in opposite palm (mixing ointment).
Injection: Mime holding syringe with index and middle fingers, plunge thumb into opposite arm.
Bandage: Wrap one flat hand around opposite wrist/forearm in circular motion.
Exercise: Clench both fists and pump arms up and down like lifting weights.
Blood: Pinch index fingertip (drop) and stroke downward like flowing red drop.
Brain: Tap forehead temple twice with curled index finger.
Man: Mime stroking mustache with thumb and index across upper lip.
Boy: Tap chin with index finger then show young height gesture.
Girl: Stroke back of curled fingers down cheek (indicating soft cheek / nose stud).
Child: Hold flat hand palm-down at waist level indicating child's height.
Lady: Touch thumb to earlobe (earring) then curve hand down gracefully.
Grandfather: 1. Mime mustache/beard, 2. Open palm moves forward in generational step.
Grandmother: 1. Stroke cheek gracefully, 2. Open palm moves forward in generational step.
Daughter: 1. Girl gesture (stroke cheek), 2. Cradle newborn baby in arms.
King: Form a crown with fingers spread atop head or sash across chest.
Judge: Pound imaginary gavel fist onto flat opposite palm twice firmly.
Horse: Two fingers straight like ears at temple, flexing forward twice.
Cow: Thumbs at temples with pinkies pointing out like cow horns.
Goat: Point two fingers under chin pulling downward like a goat's goatee beard.
Lion: Curved claws scrape forward from chest with fierce expression.
Elephant: One arm curves out from nose swinging forward like an elephant trunk.
Monkey: Scratch both armpits / ribs with fingertips hopping slightly.
Fish: Flat hand moves forward waving side-to-side like a swimming fish.
Moon: Curved index and thumb form crescent 'C' shape near eye tilted upward.
Cloud: Both hands form puffy rounded shapes drifting across sky horizontally.
Fire: Wiggle fingers upward rapidly like flickering rising flames.
Flower: Pinch fingertips together at nose smelling bloom, then open fingers into petals.
Leaf: One index finger acts as stem, opposite flat hand flutters down like leaf.
Forest: Make tree gesture with both arms spread out indicating dense woods.
Sea: Both flat hands rise and fall together mimicking gentle ocean waves.
Ocean: Wide sweeping wave motion across body with both open palms.
Mountain: Fists touch then climb steeply upward meeting at triangular peak.
Hill: Flat palm curves gently up and down tracing rolling hill contour.
Planet: One fist sits central, opposite curved hand orbits around it in a circle.
Earth: Grip round imaginary sphere with both curved hands rotating slightly.
Nature: Wide sweeping gesture with open hands admiring scenic beauty.
Mango: Mime peeling or holding curved oval fruit, bringing to mouth.
Lemon: Mime squeezing lemon half with fist, puckering lips sourly.
Garlic: Peel imaginary garlic clove with thumbs and index fingers.
Ginger: Trace knobby irregular root shape between fingertips.
Coffee: One fist grinds in circular motion on top of lower fist (grinding beans).
Egg: Both index and middle fingers tap together and crack apart downward.
Meat: Pinch fleshy web of skin between thumb and index of opposite hand.
Butter: Two fingers of right hand scrape flat across upturned left palm.
Fork: Two fingers extended like prongs poke downward into palm.
Knife: Index finger slices back and forth across edge of other flat hand.
Cup: Curved 'C' hand rests on flat opposite palm, bringing to lips.
Glass: Curved cylindrical hand shape lifted to mouth indicating drinking glass.
Bottle: Both hands trace narrow neck then wide body of cylinder.
Cook: Flat hand flips food over in imaginary pan or stirs pot.
Kitchen: Mime stirring pot then chopping on cutting board.
Market: Both hands hold bags or exchange coins forward and back.
Bag: Mime gripping handle of tote bag and lifting upward.
Chair: Two bent fingers hook over two bent fingers of other hand (sitting).
Clock: Tap wrist with index finger then circle index finger in air.
Camera: Mime holding rectangular camera and clicking index finger shutter.
Coin: Pinch small round circle between thumb and index fingertip.
Bank: Mime counting paper notes into palm then stamping teller counter.
Key: Twist imaginary key clockwise inside curled fist lock.
Lock: Curled fingers hook together and snap shut firmly.
Hammer: Fist hammers downward repeatedly onto imaginary nail on other fist.
Ladder: Both hands alternate gripping and climbing upward rungs in air.
Cloth: Pinch shirt fabric between thumb and index, rubbing texture.
Dress: Both flat palms slide down chest to thighs tracing flowing dress.
Coat: Hands grip imaginary lapels and pull coat over shoulders.
Hat: Both hands touch brim of hat above forehead.
Cap: Hand mimes pulling visor of baseball cap forward above eyes.
Wardrobe: Both hands open two tall cupboard doors outward.
Boat: Both cupped hands joined at sides rocking gently forward like a boat.
Bridge: Two fingers of both hands meet forming arch overhead.
Rail: Two fingers of right hand slide forward along two fingers of left hand.
Wheel: Both fists rotate around each other in big circular steering motion.
Path: Both open palms facing each other guide forward tracing straight road path.
Airport: Airplane 'Y' handshape taxis forward and ascends smoothly upward.
College: Flat hands clap and top hand spirals upward signifying higher learning.
Factory: Interlocking fingers bounce up and down like factory machinery cogs.
Garden: Both hands scoop forward nurturing flower blossoms growing from ground.
Floor: Both flat hands palms-down sweep outward across flat horizontal level.
Dance: Two fingers stand on flat opposite palm and sway rhythmically back and forth.
Jump: Two bent fingers crouch on palm then spring upward into air.
Fly: Both hands extended like wings gliding smoothly through air.
Make: Both fists twist together on top of each other (assembling parts).
Game: Both thumbs-up fists bump knuckles together playfully.
Magic: Fingers wiggle and burst outward mysteriously from closed palms.
Idea: Index finger touches temple then points straight upward (lightbulb).
Keep: Crossed 'V' hands tap on top of each other firmly holding possession.
Easy: Fingertips brush upward against underside of chin twice effortlessly.
Fast: Both index fingers hook and flick rapidly inward like snapping quickness.
